input.title: Undoing a Font Color implementation on a text with Background Color does not revert the Background Color when caret is on the thought text
input.body: ``` - One - Two ``` ## Step to Reproduce 1. Put the caret onto the Thought One 2. Apply Green Background Color 3. Apply Red Font Color 4. With the caret still on the text, click Undo ## Current behavior Nothing happens to Text Font Color but bullet color changes to Green. Moving caret to Thought Two makes the Font Color reverts to Background Color. Note: This is not reproducible when the caret is not on Thought One https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/479b4820-8288-4442-b68b-662498072901 ## Expected behavior Undo should revert Background Color implementation step
